description: Look up one product by its barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A, check digit validated). Returns factual data from ProductGuru: name, brand/maker, manufacturer website (when known), category, recorded attributes, and official recall notices (agency, date, notice link), plus the URL of the ProductGuru product page. Answers 'not found' when ProductGuru has no published product page for the barcode. One barcode per call; no search or listing.

ean.description: One barcode: EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A digits (string or number).
